plain_english: Thus driving, by play-discipline, the power-wheel-machine — god: I indeed, pure-formed, standing in the power-great-wheel-lord-seat.
sanskrit_cite: iti śakticakrayantraṃ krīḍāyogena vāhayan devaḥ | aham eva śuddharūpaḥ śaktimahācakranāyakapadasthaḥ

plain_english: In me indeed shines the universe, as jars and the like in a spotless mirror; from me spreads all, as dream-variety from a sleeper.
sanskrit_cite: mayy eva bhāti viśvaṃ darpaṇa iva nirmale ghatādīni | mattaḥ prasarati sarvaṃ svapnavicitratvam iva suptāt

plain_english: I indeed, universe-formed, hand-foot-and-all-natured as the body; in all I indeed shine, light-natured.
sanskrit_cite: aham eva viśvarūpaḥ karacaranādisvabhāva iva dehaḥ | sarvasmin aham eva sphurāmi bhāveṣu bhāsvarūpam iva

plain_english: Seer, hearer, smeller — bereft of body-senses though, a non-doer too: varied systems, texts, reasonings I indeed compose.
sanskrit_cite: draṣṭā śrotā ghrātā dehendriyavarjito 'py akartāpi | siddhāntāgamatarkāṃś citrān aham eva racayāmi

plain_english: Thus, duality-thought dissolved, crossing enchanting Māyā: as water in water, milk in milk — dissolved in brahman may one be.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ dvaitavikalpe galite pravilaṅghya mohinīṃ māyām | salile salilaṃ kṣīre kṣīram iva brahmaṇi layī syāt

plain_english: Thus, in the principle-host, by contemplation attaining Śiva-madeness: what sorrow, what delusion, for the brahman-beholder?
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ tattvasamūhe bhāvanayā śivamayatvam abhiyāte | kaḥ śokaḥ ko mohaḥ sarvaṃ brahmāvalokayataḥ

plain_english: Deed-fruit, good or bad, comes only from contact with false knowing; hard indeed is contact's fault — like a thief's company, though one is no thief.
sanskrit_cite: karmaphalaṃ śubham aśubhaṃ mithyājñānena saṃgamād eva | viṣamo hi saṅgadoṣas taskarayogo 'py ataskarasyeva

plain_english: World-convention-makers who tend ignorance here, fools, go to birth and death, bound by duty's locks.
sanskrit_cite: lokavyavahārakṛtāṃ ya ihāvidyām upāsate mūḍhāḥ | te yānti janmamṛtyū dharmādharmārgalābaddhāḥ

plain_english: Yet even duty-formed deeds, heaped in ignorance-time, long-heaped like cotton, perish by knowing-flame-power.
sanskrit_cite: ajñānakālanicitaṃ dharmādharmātmakaṃ tu karmāpi | cirasaṃcitam iva tūlaṃ naśyati vijñānadīptivaśāt
